summary: CSS grid with a responsive column count (breakpoints sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280 px) or intrinsic “auto-fit” columns with a minimum width.
whenToUse: KPI dashboards, card galleries, main layout + side panel.
whenNotToUse: Tabular data: use Table or DataTable.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fixed or per-breakpoint columns (mobile-first: each value applies until the next one).

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Minimum CSS length per column in auto-fit mode; takes precedence over columns.

props.name: as
props.description: Semantic element (with ul/ol use GridItem as="li").

props.name: GridItem.span
props.description: Columns spanned; below 640 px an item with span takes the full row.

inherits: Global HTML attributes; ref to the element.
accessibility: Reading order follows the DOM: do not use the grid to visually reorder meaningful content.
responsive: Media queries use literal px values (custom properties are not allowed in conditions).
Auto-fit mode adapts to the container without breakpoints.
commonMistakes: Setting columns={4} without a base: on mobile the 4 columns become too narrow. Use { base: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }.
